purpose: Add a separate causally bounded producer/consumer scheduling regression; keep the original always-ready counterexample and all of its failed candidate evidence unchanged.
mapping_correction: Actual Core1 sensorarrayAsyncLogPublishFrameSnapshot encodes the immutable text packet before publishing. Core0 AsyncLog pops/fans out science and formats periodic diagnostics. New fixture must model that current ownership, not silently move all encoding cost to Core0.
old_model_assessment: sourceTask is Core0 output-hub work, not Core1 sampling.
BLE and Transport work are unconstrained by produced descriptor counts; this can synthesize perpetual ready work after all real finite queues would have emptied.
It remains useful as a saturated-ready fairness counterexample: idle progress and successful control observations do not alone guarantee output-producer progress.
Real bounded queues do not prove TX8 safe: repeated one-tick yield windows can let lower-priority producers replenish them, and incoming control work can independently supply priority records.

minimum_new_fixture.time_and_cores: Core1 frame-production events occur on an independent monotonic schedule while Core0 executes output tasks; advancing Core0 time must not suppress Core1 production. Record produced/emitted/admitted/retired separately.
minimum_new_fixture.payloads: Use actual encoder-generated frames with immutable boot/revision/domain identities and real CRC. Preserve production output-slot count4 and current drop-oldest policy.
production_bodies_to_reuse: sensorarrayAsyncLogPublishFrameSnapshot/PopFrame or clearly scoped production output-slot helpers
minimum_new_fixture.explicit_shims: Peripheral USB/BLE SDK, timer, FreeRTOS queue/semaphore and scheduler cost are synthetic. If the full output task cannot be extracted, label the replacement as an output bridge with actual queue helpers; never call that a full production AsyncLog timing test.
minimum_new_fixture.scheduler: Model IDF fixed priority, core affinity, tick wakeups, and ready-list round-robin after higher-priority SDK work as separate events. No arbitrary per-fragment voluntary yield; no infinite independent BLE/Transport loop without a descriptor.
minimum_new_fixture.conservation: Every successful BLE DATA send must consume a successfully prepared unique slot generation; inUse = prepared + queued + active. For each layer produced = accepted + rejected, accepted = retired + expired/stale + outstanding (with drop-oldest counted). Reject any phantom work unit that has no admitted job.
minimum_new_fixture.work_budget: Keep production thresholds/reason counters and assert real idle entry and bounded non-busy retry. Preserve existing source-progress/control-deadline assertions in the old fixture; new fixture adds independent assertions rather than replacing them.
minimum_new_fixture.handoff_order: Record Transport slot generation and BLE slot generation around immediate wake. Verify copy-before-wake and no early Transport release. A future staged prepare/commit candidate must demonstrate source release before new BLE descriptor becomes consumable, even with an already-running owner.

scenarios.name: finite burst then silence
scenarios.expectation: Drain all actual admitted slots, then owner blocks with no future producer wake; no phantom work.

scenarios.name: 100Hz Core1 source / short SDK execution
scenarios.expectation: Independent source production reaches exact requested count; finite pipeline progress and control latency checked. Synthetic service cost is disclosed.

scenarios.name: same source / high-priority BTC-BTU work
scenarios.expectation: Inject SDK preemption with realistic scheduler resume ordering; compare same7/7 and experimental8/7 only in standalone test configurations.

scenarios.name: long but finite SDK wait
scenarios.expectation: Blocked BLE owner preserves its slot; output/Transport progress and per-layer drops remain accounted. No use-after-free or renamed frame.

scenarios.name: SDK reject/congestion
scenarios.expectation: Production finite DATA failure and bounded CTRL retry; no bogus sent count; no tight-ready retry loop.

scenarios.name: disconnect/reconnect
scenarios.expectation: Generation transition cancels stale queued/active records; a disconnected owner waits, and an old slot never becomes new connection data.

scenarios.name: formal USB unread / debug unread
scenarios.expectation: Real independent endpoint mock delays expire only relevant USB lanes; BLE/control producer dependencies and identity remain intact.

scenarios.name: continuous CTRL/LOG admission
scenarios.expectation: Use actual finite CTRL2/LOG2/DATA4 slots and producer priorities. Message priority and limits, producer progress and all drops remain visible.

scenarios.name: SDK never returns
scenarios.expectation: Explicit NOT_BOUNDED_BY_CURRENT_APPLICATION result; do not terminate the fake call then claim a firmware deadline or general control-delivery PASS.

acceptance_boundary: Only after meaningful new actual-function regression passes may parent reconsider a distinct HIL TX8 candidate. Existing failed logs/summary remain immutable. Neither a model pass nor a staged handoff change is proof BLE matches capture.
